targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-711 (ARC-110 x ARC-108 ascending-spiral gain validation; experiment_purpose=evidence; claim_ids=[MECH-439, ARC-108, ARC-110]) FAIL / non_degenerate=True but self-routed DECISIVE weakens is REJECTED by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-711_2026-07-04 (user-approved). The 711 build tested whether a strengthened ascending gain lets a non-motor (limbic) loop reach motor effective weight and CONVERT committed-action diversity. The limbic_loop_can_win precondition was recorded MET on 3/3 divergent seeds, but NOT by a competitive parity win: the raw 20x-forward x 5x-plasticity gain compounding through the three-factor eligibility update ran AWAY (M_cross range peak 4897.8 vs the un-gained 709/OFF ~0.02-0.12; w_eff[limbic] peak 10x-2274x w_eff[motor] across divergent seeds). A 10-2274x limbic dominance is a NEW single-loop monopoly (limbic-pinning) replacing the old F/motor-pinning, not a fair arbitration -- and it did not convert: on 2/3 divergent seeds committed-class entropy FELL below the un-gained baseline (delta -0.049 / -0.210); only the most extreme blow-up seed (42, ~2274x) rose (+0.153). The conversion question was therefore tested under a DEGENERATE (saturated) arbitration and was NOT validly measured -> non_contributory for all three claims (same non-vacuity discipline as 709; the win-gate simply lacked a saturation guard so its own substrate_not_ready_requeue branch did not fire). MECH-439-intrinsic is NOT shown (F-dominance was replaced by limbic-dominance, not dissolved into competition); ARC-108 and ARC-110 are NOT weakened (a bounded/parity ascending gain was never tested). 709->711 pattern: the raw-scalar ascending gain has no stable operating regime -- sub-threshold (709, ~0.03, never wins) or runaway (711, 10-2274x, monopolizes); the mechanism is MISSING A CONTROLLER (gain-normalization / target-parity law), a genuine NEW substrate finding, not evidence of an intrinsic ceiling. Routed /implement-substrate (amend v4_loop_segregation): bounded/normalized ascending gain + saturation guard on the limbic_loop_can_win gate; a blind same-claim gain-magnitude re-queue (711b at lower gain) is REFUSED until the controller is built. PROMOTES NOTHING; all three stay candidate + pending_retest_after_substrate.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: The ascending-spiral gain (landed ree-v3 6b660a6) has no stable parity regime: at raw scalar 20x-forward/5x-plasticity it runs the plastic ascending M_cross entries away (M_cross range peak 4897.8; w_eff[limbic] 10-2274x w_eff[motor]), replacing motor-dominance with limbic-dominance instead of restoring parity. Build a BOUNDED/normalized ascending gain -- a target-parity controller (e.g. column-normalize W_cross, clamp M_cross range, or drive w_eff[limbic] toward w_eff[motor] rather than multiply by an unbounded scalar) -- AND add a saturation guard to the experiment limbic_loop_can_win gate (require a parity band + a w_eff/M_cross ceiling so a blow-up self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue instead of a decisive FAIL). Only then re-test the conversion.

learning_extracted: The raw-scalar ascending gain has NO stable operating regime: 709 (coupling ~0.03) is sub-threshold and never wins; 711 (20x/5x) runs away to 10-2274x limbic dominance. The mechanism is missing a controller (gain-normalization / target-parity law), which is a NEW substrate finding, not evidence of an intrinsic ceiling.

A bare w_eff[limbic] >= w_eff[motor] win-gate cannot distinguish a fair parity win from a saturated blow-up; a saturation guard (parity band + w_eff/M_cross ceiling) is required or the decisive-FAIL branch fires on a degenerate arbitration.

Saturated limbic dominance does NOT produce committed-action diversity -- it collapses committed selection onto the limbic loop's single top candidate (entropy fell on 2/3 divergent seeds), i.e. it is a mirror-image of F-dominance, not its dissolution.

C1_n_seeds=1 is the per-divergent-seed PASS-count (seed 42 only of {42,44,46}), scored correctly; the 0.855-vs-0.877 all-6-seed mean is a display statistic, not the decision statistic. No instrumentation bug (concern 2 resolved).
